lines.zh: 我拍着青色翅膀穿过藤蔓
lines.en: I beat cyan wings through the vines.
I fly fast and the jungle slides backward.
I circle just under the treetops.
Light comes through my wing edges.

lines.zh: 我在两棵树间穿了一道弧
lines.en: I trace an arc between two trees.
My shadow jitters on the leaves.
I climb a little to avoid a web.
I cannot slow down; the wings are too quick.
I dive straight into the blossoms.

lines.zh: 我绕着同一朵花转了两圈
lines.en: I circle one flower twice.
I flip from a leaf's underside to its face.
I climb until the canopy.

lines.zh: 我从一朵花跳到另一朵
lines.en: I flit from one flower to the next.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀每一下都很轻
lines.en: Every wingbeat is light.

lines.zh: 我掠过一条溪，没有沾水
lines.en: I skim a stream without touching water.
I glide a stretch on the wind.
I settle beside a poppy.
My wings open and close, slowly.
I am sunning my wings in the sun.
The vine leaves block the wind.
One antenna stirs.
I take a little nectar.
The jungle is full of sound.

lines.zh: 我在同一朵花上待了很久
lines.en: I stay a long while on one flower.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀合起来像一片叶
lines.en: Folded, my wings look like a leaf.
The petal bends under me.
A bee passes beside me.
Light falls from the canopy.

lines.zh: 我落在你面前的叶子上
lines.en: I land on the leaf before you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张开，青色很亮
lines.en: My wings open, the cyan bright.

lines.zh: 你在这么大一片林子里找到我
lines.en: You found me in a forest this big.
I mean no harm; I only drink nectar.
I reach an antenna toward you.
Stay still and I will not fly off.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在阳光下变浅
lines.en: My color pales in the sun.
You reach out and I take off once.

lines.zh: 我绕你飞了一圈，看清了。
lines.en: I circled you once and got a good look.

lines.zh: 我停住，翅膀还在一开一合
lines.en: I stop, wings still fanning.
A piece of my wing edge is gone.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，又挣扎起来
lines.en: I fall to the ground and struggle up.
Much of my wing dust is gone.
I fly a little crooked now.
I rest on a leaf to recover.
I rest on a leaf, wings trembling.
The picture in my compound eyes blurs.
I cannot fly high just now.
I want somewhere to hide.
I press flat to a leaf and keep still.

lines.zh: 虞美人的味道，就在附近
lines.en: Poppy smell, and close.
I followed the wind to find it.

lines.zh: 你手上没有花，我等一等
lines.en: No flower in your hand; I will wait.
The color is right, and the smell too.
I land on your knuckle.
One sip and I leave.
My proboscis is coiled, waiting.
I have the flower's direction now.
There is pollen on you.
I circle you a third of the way.
I bump into a leaf.
You move and I hit your hand.
My wing catches a vine.
I am knocked aside and fly back.
A little wing dust falls.
I spin once in midair.
I steady myself in the air.
My wing brushes your sleeve.
Startled, I climb.
My wingtip raps the bark.

lines.zh: 一只同色的在花上等我
lines.en: One of my color waits on the flower.
We circle, neither landing.
Our wings almost touch.

lines.zh: 她落在虞美人上，我跟着
lines.en: She settles on a poppy; I follow.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后飞过藤蔓
lines.en: We fly through the vines one behind the other.
The jungle is vast, and we share the path.

lines.zh: 我们一起落在一片叶上
lines.en: We land together on one leaf.

lines.zh: 她的翅膀比我的亮一点
lines.en: Her wings are a shade brighter.
I follow her line of flight.

lines.zh: 我们停在两朵相邻的花上
lines.en: We settle on two neighbouring flowers.
I land on the leaf, having no hands.
I stir it with a leg.
It is not a flower; I leave it.
I stand on it; it weighs nothing.
I take off and it falls.

lines.zh: 我用腿夹了一下，夹不住
lines.en: I grip with a leg and cannot hold.
I sniff it; not nectar.
I rest on it a moment.
I cup it with my forelegs; it will not stay.
I drop down, then lift off again.

lines.zh: 我停在一朵花上，翅膀不动
lines.en: I settle on a flower, wings still.
You move in my compound eyes.
I judge the distance.
One wing-fold and I am ready to go.
My wingtips fold and I hover.
I rise to the height of your eyes.
I loop once and look again.
In this jungle I am never lost.

lines.zh: 丛林这么大，我的青翅很显眼。
lines.en: In this jungle my cyan wings stand out.

lines.zh: 我落在离你一臂的叶上
lines.en: I land one arm's length away.
I circle you, high and low.
Wherever you walk, I follow.

lines.zh: 我从来不停在一个地方
lines.en: I never stay in one place.
I know every flower in this jungle.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，从一个枝头到下一个
lines.en: I follow you branch to branch.
You take two steps; I fly a circle.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你肩上停了一下
lines.en: My shadow rests on your shoulder.
I do not tire; the wind holds me.
Look back and I am on a flower.

lines.zh: 我一直在你头顶那颗树附近
lines.en: I stay near the tree above you.
I strike you once with a wing.
My body bumps your face.
This is all the force I have.
I fly back and land far off.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下，翅膀打在你手背
lines.en: I lunge and my wing hits your hand.
My legs catch you once.
I strike, then flee upward.
My antenna brushes your cheek.

lines.zh: 这一点力气伤不到你，我知道
lines.en: This will not hurt you; I know.
I circle back and lunge again.
I flip up from a leaf's underside.
My wings open for the first time.
A cyan glint flickers in the jungle.
I have just come out of the chrysalis.
My casing still hangs on the vine.
I take flight; the wind is warm.
I crawl out from a leaf's underside.
My wings have just opened, still damp.
I rest on the vine for a breath.
I fly away from the split casing.

lines.zh: 火的热气把我的翅膀烤卷
lines.en: The heat of fire curls my wings.

lines.zh: 我从树冠落下，翻了好几圈
lines.en: I fall from the canopy, tumbling.

lines.zh: 水粘住我的翅膀，我起不来
lines.en: Water glues my wings and I cannot rise.
The blast blows me far away.

lines.zh: 我的青色鳞粉掉了一路。
lines.en: My cyan scales trail off behind me.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的翅膀一阵发麻
lines.en: That force numbs my wings.

lines.zh: 花都谢了，我飞得没有力气
lines.en: The flowers have withered and I fly weak.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的翅膀全白了
lines.en: Lightning flashes and my wings go white.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我的翅膀扇不动
lines.en: The void below; my wings beat nothing.
